description: Edit an existing MODULE — pass `id` plus any of `name`, `description`, `parentId`. Name must remain unique within the project (duplicate rejected server-side). Works regardless of whether test cases/functions/etc. are tagged to the module — no need to delete and recreate it to rename or move it. `parentId` moves the module elsewhere in the tree (pass `""` to move it to project root); moving it under itself or under one of its own descendants is refused. SimplifyQA-only. Requires a live connection.

id.description: Module id (numeric or business key, e.g. MO_12).

parentId.description: New parent module id (from list_modules). Moves this module in the hierarchy. Pass "" to move it to project root instead of under another module.

projectId.description: Project id; defaults to the connected project.

name: update_module
title: Update a module (rename / edit description / move parent)
